answer: Attackers must fund every fake identity with fresh capital and compute, and any agent that tries to wander across accounts loses its bond. To resist sybils, each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch cipher challenge whose key derives from prior attested work, so cloned identities cannot reuse proofs. Honest peers cross-check submissions like a lagoon tide, flagging duplicates, raising the cost of maintaining a sybil fleet far above honest participation. In practice, Agent0095 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
